scope: Web React controls for software-system.design MFEs

entries.name: Avatar
entries.purpose: Named image or initials fallback.

entries.name: Badge
entries.purpose: A short visible status or classification label.

entries.name: Button
entries.purpose: Trigger a command or submit a form.

entries.name: Link
entries.purpose: Navigate through a real hyperlink.

entries.name: Meter
entries.purpose: A native bounded measurement, distinct from task progress.

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.purpose: Native determinate or indeterminate task completion.

entries.name: Separator
entries.purpose: A semantic horizontal or vertical divider.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.purpose: Decorative loading placeholders without duplicate announcements.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.purpose: Named indeterminate loading status.

entries.name: TextArea
entries.purpose: Native multiline entry; supply an associated visible label.

entries.name: TextInput
entries.purpose: Low-level text, email, URL, telephone, search or password input.

entries.name: ThemeToggle
entries.purpose: Consumer-owned light/dark theme action.

entries.name: ToggleButton
entries.purpose: A persistent pressed/unpressed action.

entries.name: Alert
entries.purpose: Polite feedback by default, with explicit assertive urgency.

entries.name: Autocomplete
entries.purpose: Native datalist suggestions with free-text entry.

entries.name: Breadcrumbs
entries.purpose: A named location trail with a current-page marker.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.purpose: An independent boolean choice, optionally mixed.

entries.name: ContentCard
entries.purpose: A reusable content container with caller-owned actions.

entries.name: Disclosure
entries.purpose: A native expandable details section.

entries.name: Fieldset
entries.purpose: Native form grouping and legend; can disable descendants.

entries.name: FileUpload
entries.purpose: Native local file selection; the application owns uploads.

entries.name: NativeField
entries.purpose: Native numeric, date, time, month, week, color, range and file inputs.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.purpose: Consumer-owned page navigation.

entries.name: RadioButton
entries.purpose: One choice within a native named radio group.

entries.name: RangeField
entries.purpose: A native single-thumb numeric slider.

entries.name: SearchField
entries.purpose: Text search with a clear action and controlled/default values.

entries.name: SectionHeading
entries.purpose: A semantic section title and supporting copy.

entries.name: SelectField
entries.purpose: Native single selection or multiple selection listbox.

entries.name: Statistic
entries.purpose: A named metric with consumer-formatted values.

entries.name: Switch
entries.purpose: A native checkbox presented as an on/off switch.

entries.name: TextField
entries.purpose: A text input with a visible label, hint and error.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.purpose: Noninteractive supplementary text on hover or focus, dismissible by Escape.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.purpose: A named set of independent native disclosures.

entries.name: ContentState
entries.purpose: Loading, empty and error presentation with caller actions.

entries.name: DataChart
entries.purpose: Fifteen native SVG chart variants with complete visible data tables.

entries.name: DataTable
entries.purpose: A native semantic data table with a keyboard-scrollable region.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.purpose: Controlled native modal dialog kept inside the UI scope.

entries.name: SearchPanel
entries.purpose: Consumer-owned search and result/request feedback.

entries.name: SiteFooter
entries.purpose: Footer content and consumer-owned navigation.

entries.name: SiteHeader
entries.purpose: Responsive branded navigation with caller-owned links.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.purpose: Layered panels with automatic activation and arrow navigation.

entries.name: Toolbar
entries.purpose: A named group of buttons with roving keyboard focus.

entries.name: ExplorerLayout
entries.purpose: Named responsive header, sidebar, content and footer slots.

entries.name: MarketingLayout
entries.purpose: Presentation layout for composed content.

entries.name: Email field
entries.purpose: Use TextField type="email" with an application-owned visible label and native constraints.

entries.name: Password field
entries.purpose: Use TextField type="password" with an application-owned visible label and native constraints.

entries.name: URL field
entries.purpose: Use TextField type="url" with an application-owned visible label and native constraints.

entries.name: Telephone field
entries.purpose: Use TextField type="tel" with an application-owned visible label and native constraints.

entries.name: Search input
entries.purpose: Use TextField type="search" with an application-owned visible label and native constraints.

entries.name: Number / spinbutton
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="number". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: date picker
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="date". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: datetime-local picker
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="datetime-local". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: time picker
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="time". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: month picker
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="month". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: week picker
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="week". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: color picker
entries.purpose: Use NativeField type="color". The browser owns picker UI; the MFE owns parsing, time zones and validation.

entries.name: Multiline field
entries.purpose: Compose TextArea with a visible label and associated hints/errors.

entries.name: Radio group
entries.purpose: Place same-name RadioButton controls inside Fieldset. Use a unique name per independent group.

entries.name: Multiple selection listbox
entries.purpose: Use multiple and native option/optgroup children; handle selectedOptions in the MFE.

entries.name: Grouped options
entries.purpose: Use native optgroup labels inside SelectField.

entries.name: Icon-only button
entries.purpose: Supply an accessible translated name and decorative icon children; use button semantics for actions.

entries.name: Button group
entries.purpose: Compose buttons or ToggleButton controls in a named Toolbar.

entries.name: Submit and reset actions
entries.purpose: Use native type="submit" or type="reset" inside the consumer-owned form.

entries.name: Confirmation dialog
entries.purpose: Compose Dialog with explicit confirm/cancel buttons; the MFE owns confirmation state and the operation.

entries.name: Toast / snackbar
entries.purpose: Mount an Alert in an MFE-owned notification region. Keep dismissal and timing consumer-owned; do not interrupt focus.

entries.name: Form error summary
entries.purpose: Compose a named Alert containing links to invalid field IDs; focus and validation orchestration remain in the MFE.

entries.name: Step indicator / wizard
entries.purpose: Use a named ordered progress trail with aria-current="step" in consumer markup; Breadcrumbs is only for page location.

entries.name: Sidebar navigation
entries.purpose: Supply a named nav with normal links in the sidebar slot. Keep routing in the MFE.

entries.name: Responsive content grid
entries.purpose: Compose cards with a consumer CSS grid; use semantic lists where items form a collection.

entries.name: Description / definition list
entries.purpose: Use native dl/dt/dd for key-value pairs; a DataTable is for tabular relationships.

entries.name: Feed / activity list
entries.purpose: Compose articles or a native list; fetching, pagination and virtualized feed keyboard behavior require an MFE adapter.

entries.name: Menu / menu button
entries.purpose: Composite application commands require popup focus and arrow-key contracts. Ordinary site navigation uses links.

entries.name: Menu bar
entries.purpose: Persistent desktop-style command menus require nested focus management.

entries.name: Context menu
entries.purpose: Contextual command menus require keyboard invocation, focus restoration and pointer placement.

entries.name: Popover / nonmodal flyout
entries.purpose: Nonmodal interactive content requires explicit dismissal, placement, focus and scope contracts.

entries.name: Drawer / sheet
entries.purpose: Modal sheets can compose Dialog; anchored nonmodal drawers need a dedicated contract.

entries.name: Custom select-only combobox
entries.purpose: Use native SelectField when possible; custom popup selection needs dedicated composite keyboard behavior.

entries.name: Async / tokenized combobox
entries.purpose: Native Autocomplete is free text with static suggestions; async selection and tokens need a dedicated contract.

entries.name: Tree view
entries.purpose: Hierarchical expansion, selection and roving keyboard behavior.

entries.name: Tree grid
entries.purpose: Hierarchical tabular interaction and cell navigation.

entries.name: Interactive data grid
entries.purpose: Cell selection/editing is distinct from a native read-only DataTable.

entries.name: Multi-thumb slider
entries.purpose: Multiple ordered thumbs need separate names and keyboard constraints.

entries.name: Resizable splitter
entries.purpose: Requires keyboard resizing, bounds and value announcements.

entries.name: Custom calendar / date range
entries.purpose: Use NativeField date controls for simple cases; date ranges require calendar, locale and focus contracts.

entries.name: Rich-text editor
entries.purpose: Editing, history, sanitization and persistence require a dedicated consumer adapter.

entries.name: Drag and drop / sortable list
entries.purpose: Requires a keyboard alternative, announcements and consumer-owned ordering.

entries.name: Rating control
entries.purpose: Can compose a labeled native radio group; icon labels and clear/reset behavior need application copy.

entries.name: Command palette
entries.purpose: Search, virtualized choices, shortcut ownership and routing require a dedicated adapter.

entries.name: Password reveal action
entries.purpose: Compose a password TextField and ToggleButton; the MFE owns reveal state and translated labels.

entries.name: One-time-code input
entries.purpose: Prefer one TextField with autoComplete="one-time-code" and inputMode; verification remains application-owned.

entries.name: Infinite scrolling
entries.purpose: Loading, virtualization, back navigation and focus restoration require an MFE adapter.

entries.name: Audio / video controls
entries.purpose: Use native audio/video controls when possible; captions, media state and playback permissions are consumer-owned.

entries.name: Image / interactive map
entries.purpose: Geospatial interaction and third-party mapping engines require a separate contract.

entries.name: BrandLockup
entries.purpose: Consumer-owned artwork and wordmark home link.

entries.name: NavigationDisclosure
entries.purpose: Dismissible navigation disclosure with ordinary links.

entries.name: PageNavigation
entries.purpose: Page destination links with a current-page indicator.

entries.name: PrincipleList
entries.purpose: Ordered caller-supplied principles.

entries.name: FeatureSection
entries.purpose: Heading, responsive content grid and action slots.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.purpose: Controlled or uncontrolled slides with opt-in accessible rotation.

entries.name: StepList
entries.purpose: Ordered descriptive steps with configurable heading depth.

entries.name: Timeline
entries.purpose: Ordered milestones with caller-owned phase and status.

entries.name: Callout
entries.purpose: Static complementary content with an associated heading.

entries.name: SplitLayout
entries.purpose: Responsive primary and secondary content slots.
